items.name: libpng
items.summary: A library of functions for manipulating PNG image format files
items.description:
The libpng package contains a library of functions for creating and
manipulating PNG (Portable Network Graphics) image format files.  PNG
is a bit-mapped graphics format similar to the GIF format.  PNG was
created to replace the GIF format, since GIF uses a patented data
compression algorithm.

Libpng should be installed if you need to manipulate PNG format image
files.

items.name: libcdio-paranoia
items.summary: CD paranoia on top of libcdio
items.description:
This CDDA reader distribution ('libcdio-cdparanoia') reads audio from the
CDROM directly as data, with no analog step between, and writes the
data to a file or pipe as .wav, .aifc or as raw 16 bit linear PCM.

Split off from libcdio to allow more flexible licensing and to be compatible
with cdparanoia-III-10.2's license. And also, libcdio is just too large.

tools for verifying that the DNS server is operating properly.

items.name: units
items.summary: A utility for converting amounts from one unit to another
items.description:
Units converts an amount from one unit to another, or tells you what
mathematical operation you need to perform to convert from one unit to
another. The units program can handle multiplicative scale changes as
well as conversions such as Fahrenheit to Celsius.

items.name: flac-libs
items.summary: Libraries for the Free Lossless Audio Codec
items.description:
FLAC stands for Free Lossless Audio Codec. Grossly oversimplified, FLAC
is similar to Ogg Vorbis, but lossless. The FLAC project consists of
the stream format, reference encoders and decoders in library form,
flac, a command-line program to encode and decode FLAC files, metaflac,
a command-line metadata editor for FLAC files and input plugins for
various music players.
This package contains the FLAC libraries.
